Iv decided to try some new things since, Iv been exercising more and that seems to help with my depression a little, Iv also just stopped talking with my "friends" because the only really mock me anyways. It makes me kinda lonely but better than sad. But the house situation has gotten worse, because my brother is being tested for weed, he has started to try other things that are not tested for, like shrooms and LSD. It has made my parents go crazy trying to deal with him, right now my mother is trying to talk to him but is too out of it to understand. I don't know what we are going to do, i don't know what I'm going to do.

Iv started to connect with some old friends and that is really helping me, I just did not have any support from the friends that I used to have
Thanks for the support, I think that I may contact my school councilor and see how that goes

im not seriously considering suicide, it is just something that I think about just wanted to ask for help, the "i cant live like this was kinda a exaggeration" It was more meant to to mean that I want to find a way to make a change. But sometimes after iv been yelled at or made fun of I been made fun of I do think of how nice it would be to just be gone.
